articles.text: 2. The Commission may adopt a decision imposing fines not exceeding 6 % of annual turnover where they intentionally or negligently: (a) supply incorrect, incomplete or misleading information in response to a simple request or request by a decision pursuant to Article 67; (b) refuse to submit to an inspection pursuant to Article 69.
